intro.title: About Me
intro.paragraph1: I am Abdulrahman Nasser Al-Mughyir, a graduate with an Intermediate Diploma in Full-Stack Web Development from the Applied College at Taibah University in Medina, Saudi Arabia. I combine knowledge of web development with practical experience in digital systems, data organization, and operational and administrative tasks.
intro.paragraph2: I have gained practical experience in hotel reception, sales, and point-of-sale operations, alongside developing independent and academic web projects. I am interested in technology, accuracy, information organization, and problem-solving. I aim to continuously develop my skills and contribute to a productive professional environment.
